d:
Exploring Belo Horizonte, one of Brazil's less touristy cities, all by myself. In this video, I walk across the city, explore local streets, and head towards the Pampulha region to discover a different side of Brazil.
During my adventure, I get lost in the city, but two lovely local women come to my help. What happened next made this experience even more memorable.
Join me as I explore Belo Horizonte, meet amazing locals, and discover the unexpected side of Brazil.
